subject: council.history.no_winner_arena_2026_10_06
summary: A historical RevenueSystem Council 'No-Winner' arena established adversarial self-check patterns: self-attack before criticism, steelman before objection, evidence-backed bias alerts, no vote overriding a documented domain blocker, bounded debate rounds, and no member leaderboard.

historical_rules: objection states assumption, risk, required evidence and mitigation
bias alerts require evidence or pattern
majority vote cannot override a documented domain blocker
debate closes after two rounds unless material new evidence appears
unresolved is preferable to false approval
chair_constraints: L/XL closure requires strongest dissent and strongest counter-evidence
time expiry yields DEFERRED/UNRESOLVED rather than APPROVED
routing derives from risk and affected domains
